BL-386 — a sell order's floor price is a reservation price, not a money printer

rows.requirement: Item-spanning: order_book_harness proves the clearing invariant — no corporation's clearing income exceeds its cleared quantity times the market's resolved price; an order with floor above the resolved price clears nothing and retains its pool; at/below clears at the resolved price.
The auto-clear pass holds any order whose floor_price exceeds ref_price (clears nothing) and pays rem * ref_price otherwise — the max(rp, floor) crediting is gone.
trade_floor_multiple default re-tuned (1.0 -> 0.25) so a rival's standing orders still clear on a glutted market under the fixed rule; the reservation dial is real.
The spec that certified the defect is corrected: MARKETS.md step 11 restates the reservation rule; the player-sell-orders R2 row is rewritten in its cold store.

groups.title: BL-396 — the wire parser range-checks every field or rejects the command

rows.requirement: Item-spanning: smoke.js asserts out-of-range verb, type, target, road_tier, workforce, unit_type and quantity are each refused AND the world is unchanged after each refusal; type=200 (the segfault) is a refusal.

Every COMMAND field parses wide, range-checks against its destination's real domain, and any violation rejects the whole command rejected_invalid — no truncation, wrapping, or silent clamping remains.
corp_verb_count is declared beside the corp_verb enum so the range check cannot drift.
